title: Navajo Code Talkers' unbroken code
summary: Navajo Marines built and used a code based on their language to send fast, secure battlefield messages in the Pacific War.
why: Sped up front-line communication and is credited with some decisive victories.

notes.problem: Source: 'are credited with some decisive victories'.

unsung.contribution: Created and transmitted coded messages in the Navajo language for the US Marines.
unsung.recognition: They received no recognition until their operation was declassified in 1968.
